findings.text: follow-on: non_equivalent_commits and patch_equivalent_commits are populated only when release_residue is true, so the promotion audit's row (promotion.py:5580, default release_residue=False) reports an empty non_equivalent_commits for a divergent dirty tree, an unmeasured absence read as a measured zero.

item_verdicts.diff: read d4951807 and 1eddff9f against base 344c3af9; routing.py +64/-4 (the equivalence helper, the classification branch, the release guard and a divergence-base residue computation), test_gc_releases_squash_landed_worktrees.py +146, test_crew_gc.py +13/-1, the fragment +79.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_gc_releases_squash_landed_worktrees.py with an equivalent commit that releases with its residue saved, a non-equivalent commit that is kept and named, and a live-claimed tree left untouched; the manifest records the head arm running that file, 52 passed, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to release a dirty worktree every one of whose commits has a patch-equivalent on the integration head; reckon/crew/routing.py:658 _commits_beyond_merge_base supplies the comparison and routing.py:747-752 makes it a dirty-integrated classification.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, naming both gate arms, the negative control and their logs in the run directory, with machine-readable baseline_suite and after_suite.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares routing.py, tests/test_gc_releases_squash_landed_worktrees.py, tests/test_crew_gc.py and the evidence fragment; the diff d4951807 plus the docs commit 1eddff9f touches exactly those.

justifications.durability: dropping the equivalence branch reddens test_a_squash_landed_dirty_tree_releases_with_its_residue_saved at tests/test_gc_releases_squash_landed_worktrees.py:79, and its assertions (line 81) compare the row against a head the test read from git, not one it passed in.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite (344c3af9, 49 passed) and after_suite (d4951807, 52 passed) each name a readable log and add no failure id, and the head arm ran the done_when's test file.
justifications.fit: the helper follows the module's subprocess idiom and introduces no plan- or ticket-shaped name, though the two new report fields are emitted by callers that never measure them.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:747-752 classifies a divergent dirty tree whose every commit is patch-equivalent as dirty-integrated, which garbage_collect at routing.py:1244 then releases through _save_and_release_worktree's residue path — the goal's release.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff d4951807..1eddff9f touches only routing.py, the two declared test files and the declared evidence fragment; the divergence-base residue computation at routing.py:1036 is required by the same landed-elsewhere case.
